en.title: Four Games Exit Xbox Game Pass This August: Are You Ready?
en.summary: Microsoft has unveiled the latest slate of titles departing Xbox Game Pass in August 2026. Subscribers have a limited window to experience these games before they vanish from the service.
en.body:
The digital doors of Xbox Game Pass are swinging shut on a quartet of games this August 2026, with Microsoft confirming their departure on the 15th. This roster includes a mix of genres and experiences, giving players a final fortnight to dive in or finish up.

Among the departing titles is **Aliens: Fireteam Elite**, the cooperative third-person shooter that thrusts players into the iconic Xenomorph-infested universe. Developed by Cold Iron Studios, this game offers intense squad-based combat against hordes of aliens, a familiar yet engaging loop for fans of the franchise. Alongside it, **Firewatch**, Campo Santo's critically acclaimed narrative adventure, will also be leaving the service. Known for its stunning art style, compelling story, and intimate character development, Firewatch is a poignant journey through isolation and mystery in the Wyoming wilderness.

Also on the chopping block is **Atlas Fallen**, the action RPG from Deck13 Interactive where players wield sand-based powers to battle mythical creatures in a collapsing world. Its unique combat system and visually striking environments offered a fresh take on the genre. Rounding out the list is **Menace**, a newer addition that arrived in 2026. This sci-fi, turn-based tactical RPG puts players in command of a Republic Marine Corps task force aboard the cruiser TCRN Impetus, facing threats from pirates, corporations, and an alien invasion. A key feature of **Menace** is its permadeath mechanic, adding significant stakes to every tactical decision.

## A Final Farewell to Fan Favorites

For many, the departure of **Firewatch** and **Aliens: Fireteam Elite** will sting the most. **Firewatch**, in particular, is often cited as a must-play for its emotional storytelling and immersive atmosphere. Its absence from Game Pass means players will need to purchase it if they wish to experience its unique narrative. Similarly, **Aliens: Fireteam Elite** offers a solid co-op experience that many have enjoyed, and its exit might prompt a last-minute scramble for those seeking alien-slaying action.

It's worth noting that the upcoming **Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2**, slated for release on August 25th, will *not* be joining the Game Pass catalog upon its launch. This means players looking to jump into the sequel will need to purchase it separately. For those who want to hold onto these departing titles, Xbox Game Pass subscribers can typically purchase them at a discounted rate before they are removed from the service, offering a way to keep these games in their libraries permanently.

## What's Next for Game Pass

Microsoft consistently refreshes the Xbox Game Pass library, adding new titles while others depart. While these four games are confirmed for an August 15th exit, further announcements regarding future additions and removals are expected. Players are advised to check the official Xbox mobile app for the most up-to-date information and to plan their gaming sessions accordingly.
